jobDescription: ZS is a place where passion changes lives. We are looking for experienced leaders with strong Patient Support Services (PSS) and Salesforce CRM/PRM implementation expertise to lead large, complex patient services transformation programs. This role is accountable for end‑to‑end delivery, solution development, team leadership (including contractors and techno‑functional specialists), and growth of new client programs. The Manager sits at the intersection of strategy, solution architecture, delivery execution, and business development, working closely with senior client stakeholders, ZS leadership, and multi‑disciplinary delivery teams. The ideal candidate brings hands‑on implementation experience, a proven ability to build and lead diverse delivery teams, and demonstrated success in selling and scaling new programs across global life sciences clients. What You’ll Do Program Leadership & Delivery Ownership Own end‑to‑end delivery of large‑scale Patient CRM / PRM implementations on Salesforce Health Cloud and Life Sciences Cloud, from discovery through go‑live and hypercare. Lead multiple workstreams across enrollment, case management, reimbursement, patient engagement, nurse educator workflows, and AI‑enabled capabilities. Establish delivery governance including scope, roadmap, release planning, risk management, quality assurance, and executive reporting. Ensure solutions are scalable, compliant, and reusable across brands, markets, and therapeutic areas. Solution Development & Architecture Leadership Lead solution development by shaping end‑to‑end functional and technical designs in partnership with solution architects and engineering leads. Drive key design decisions across Health Cloud data models, service processes, integrations, security, and extensibility patterns. Ensure alignment between business objectives, Salesforce platform capabilities, and long‑term client technology strategy. Champion an OOTB‑first, accelerator‑driven approach to improve speed‑to‑value and consistency across programs. Team Leadership & Resource Management Build, lead, and mentor diverse delivery teams, including ZS consultants, offshore/onshore resources, contractors, and specialized techno‑functional roles. Own staffing strategy, onboarding, performance management, and capability development across programs. Foster strong collaboration across business analysts, architects, developers, QA, data/integration specialists, and change management teams. Stakeholder Management & Client Advisory Serve as the senior client advisor, engaging with executive stakeholders across business, IT, operations, and compliance. Lead executive‑level workshops to define future‑state operating models, KPIs, governance structures, and transformation roadmaps. Advise clients on best practices in patient services, reimbursement models, digital adherence, specialty and rare disease programs. Manage escalations, align expectations, and ensure sustained client satisfaction and value realization. Selling & Program Expansion Identify, shape, and sell new programs within existing and new client accounts. Lead or significantly contribute to pursuits, RFPs, and proposals, including solutioning, scope definition, estimates, resourcing models, and delivery approach. Partner with ZS leadership to grow long‑term client relationships and expand PSS technology footprint. Contribute to development of reusable assets, accelerators, and thought leadership to support go‑to‑market efforts. Data, Integration & Insights Leadership Provide oversight on integration strategy across HUB vendors, specialty pharmacies, EMR partners, and broader patient ecosystems. Guide data and reporting strategy for therapy initiation, adherence, operational performance, and patient outcomes . Ensure analytics and insights are embedded into solution design to support decision‑making and continuous improvement. What You’ll Bring 10–14 years of experience in technology consulting, with significant hands‑on Salesforce implementation experience . Proven track record leading end‑to‑end CRM/PRM implementations , preferably on Salesforce Health Cloud or Life Sciences Cloud . Strong background in life science/pharma essential. Experience and exposure to pharma patient services is preferable . This includes HUB operations, reimbursement, specialty therapies, oncology, or rare disease programs. Demonstrated experience managing large, diverse teams , including contractors and specialized techno‑functional roles. Proven ability to sell, scope, and grow new programs with senior client stakeholders. Excellent leadership, communication, and executive‑level presentation skills. Preferred Qualifications Salesforce certifications: Health Cloud Consultant, Life Sciences Cloud, or Architecture certifications. Experience working with large global pharma clients across multi‑brand and multi‑market programs. Exposure to AI‑driven, agentic, or automation‑led workflows in patient services or CRM ecosystems. Senior Talent Sourcer – Global Hiring About Talent Sourcing & Intelligence (TSI) The Talent Sourcing & Intelligence (TSI) team is a strategic global function that partners closely with Talent Acquisition and business leaders to identify, engage, and attract exceptional talent across consulting, technology, analytics, AI, life sciences, and corporate functions. Beyond sourcing, TSI drives market intelligence, talent mapping, competitor research, workforce insights, and leverages AI-powered recruiting technologies to enable smarter hiring decisions. As trusted advisors, we help shape talent strategies that support ZS’s global growth. Role Overview We are looking for a passionate, curious, and technology-savvy Senior Talent Sourcer to join our Global Talent Sourcing & Intelligence team. In this role, you will partner with recruiters and hiring managers to develop innovative sourcing strategies, build diverse talent pipelines, generate market intelligence, and leverage GenAI and AI-enabled recruiting tools to identify and engage world-class talent globally. If you enjoy solving complex hiring challenges, uncovering hidden talent, and using data and technology to influence hiring decisions, we’d love to hear from you. Key Responsibilities Partner with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to develop innovative sourcing strategies for global hiring across multiple business functions and geographies. Build and maintain high-quality talent pipelines through proactive sourcing, networking, referrals, social platforms, professional communities, and industry events. Utilize advanced sourcing techniques including Boolean search, X-Ray search, market mapping, and competitive intelligence. Leverage AI and GenAI-powered recruiting tools to accelerate candidate discovery, personalize outreach, automate research, and improve sourcing productivity. Create talent maps, organizational charts, competitor analyses, succession maps, and market intelligence reports to support strategic hiring decisions. Conduct industry research including talent availability, hiring trends, compensation benchmarking, competitor movement, and emerging skill landscapes. Partner with recruiters to define target talent personas and build long-term pipelines for critical and niche skill areas. Develop compelling candidate engagement strategies and employer branding initiatives to attract passive talent. Maintain accurate sourcing activity, talent insights, and pipeline data within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and CRM. Present sourcing insights and market intelligence to recruiters, hiring managers, and senior stakeholders. Support strategic hiring initiatives including new capability builds, leadership hiring, geographic expansion, and workforce planning projects. Champion continuous improvement by adopting emerging sourcing technologies, AI innovations, automation, and best practices. Strong expertise in internet research, Boolean search, X-Ray search, LinkedIn Recruiter, and other sourcing platforms. Experience creating talent maps, competitor intelligence reports, and market research. Exposure to AI/GenAI recruiting platforms (e.g., LinkedIn AI, Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini, sourcing automation tools, talent intelligence platforms, CRM automation) is highly desirable. Strong analytical and research capabilities with the ability to translate market insights into actionable hiring recommendations. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with confidence engaging senior professionals globally. Ability to manage multiple searches simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail. Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and recruitment systems (ATS/CRM). Curiosity, innovation mindset, and enthusiasm for leveraging technology to transform recruiting. Solid grasp of network fundamentals , including TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, and connectivity troubleshooting. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS. Finance Associate - Client Accounting (Sales Operations) We seek a financial professional for a Finance Associate - Client Accounting role in our Pune, India office. As an Associate in Sales Operations / Order Management, within Client Accounting, you will support the contract-to-project setup process for professional services engagements helping ensure signed client documents (e.g., MSA/SOW/PO) are translated into accurate SAP customer project/WBS and billing setup so delivery teams can execute and Finance can invoice and apply revenue policies. Your work is execution-focused and completed within defined SOPs, templates, and checklists, with routine review by senior team members and clear escalation paths for exceptions. What y ou’ll d o: Contract intake, completeness checks, and operational validation (under supervision) Perform initial review for completeness and readiness of incoming client documents (e.g., fully executed agreement, required fields/data present), and organize the contract record so it is accessible to internal stakeholders. Validate that key operational terms are clear enough to enable project setup and billing setup, and flag gaps/ambiguities for senior/Finance/Legal review rather than interpreting them independently. SAP services project setup support (functional end-user scope) You will support foundational setup activities that enable billing, using guided processes rather than configuration work. Support creation/maintenance of billing items for customer projects, in collaboration or overlap with billing team (including selecting contract type such as Fixed Price or Time & Expenses; assigning work packages; entering amounts/caps; maintaining billing due dates/billing plan items; and capturing customer references such as PO) Cross-functional coordination (primarily internal-facing) Coordinate with Sales, Delivery/Project teams, and finance to collect missing inputs, clarify basic items (e.g., dates, PO references, billing schedule), and keep the setup moving through the standard workflow. Provide routine status updates and document actions/decisions taken, maintaining an audit-ready trail of changes and approvals as required by the workflow. Documentation hygiene and operational reporting support Maintain organized records and trackers (e.g., contract intake status, setup progress, exception logs) to support day-to-day visibility and handoffs. Support basic operational reporting aligned to the process (e.g., volumes processed, cycle time, rework themes) as defined by the team’s governance model. Contract elements you will typically review and validate within Associate scope of experience & expertise You will focus on operationally actionable contract elements that drive project setup and billing structure—not legal interpretation. Common validation checklist items include: Scope/deliverables and timelines: ensuring deliverables, milestones, and timelines are stated clearly enough to align to project structure and billing phases. Payment structure and triggers: confirming whether billing is milestone-based, periodic, or time & expenses—and ensuring the setup can reflect those triggers. Basic contract data required for setup: parties/contact information, effective/expiration dates, and required customer references (e.g., PO) for linkage to sales/billing documents. Billing plan and method alignment: verifying that the invoice method and revenue method classification selected/entered aligns to the contracted payment structure (and escalating mismatches). Revenue recognition awareness (coordination-only; no accounting ownership) You are expected to have awareness of ASC 606/IFRS 15 concepts and recognize when contract terms may impact Finance’s revenue decisions; however, you do not determine accounting treatment, standalone selling price allocation, or final revenue recognition conclusions. Practical awareness expected: Familiarity with the five-step model structure (identify contract; identify performance obligations; determine transaction price; allocate price; recognize revenue) at a high level, so you can spot terms that could affect setup and downstream treatment. Accuracy and attention to detail: when translating contract terms into SAP billing/project setup fields. Process discipline: ability to follow SOPs, maintain documentation, and preserve required audit trails. Clear written communication: for internal coordination and structured escalation. Comfort working with global stakeholders: through defined handoffs, including support for contracts across regions via documented workflows. What you’ll bring: Master’s degree in finance, economics, or business required, with a strong record of academic achievement. 0-3 years of Sales and Order Management experience. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PPT, Outlook), SAP experience desirable; Strong analytic and critical thinking abilities. Effective oral and written communication skills that enable strong relationship-building and stakeholder management. Strong attention to detail. Motivated and proactive. Professional objectivity and judgment to know when to challenge activities. Ability to multi-task in a fast paced, rapidly-changing environment. Fluency in English Client-first mentality Intense work ethic Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach How you’ll grow: Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions Hybrid working model: ZS is committed to a Flexible and Connected way of working. ZSers are onsite at clients or ZS offices three days a week. Combined flexibility to work remotely two days a week is also available. ENTERPRISE ARCHITECT – Beyond Healthcare As an Enterprise Data & AI Architect at ZS, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and delivering large-scale data modernization and AI transformation programs for global clients. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, enterprise data architecture, cloud platforms, and GenAI innovation. You will define target-state architectures and transformation roadmaps, design governance-driven and cloud-native data platforms, and guide cross-functional engineering teams through execution. The role requires strong experience in enterprise data ecosystems, AI/GenAI enablement, cloud-native design, and client-facing technical leadership. Key Focus Areas Enterprise Data & AI Architecture Define and evolve enterprise-wide architecture across data ingestion, integration, governance, analytics, and AI/GenAI layers . Cloud & Platform Modernization Shape modernization strategies leveraging Azure, AWS, or GCP , including data platform upgrades, legacy modernization, and cloud-native adoption. Governance, Security & Compliance Establish data governance, privacy, metadata management, and responsible AI guardrails , enabling compliant and scalable enterprise platforms. GenAI & Innovation Enablement Evaluate and integrate GenAI, agentic AI, and advanced analytics use cases (RAG, assistants, automation, synthetic data) into client ecosystems. What you’ll do : Own and evolve the enterprise data & AI architecture blueprint, spanning data platforms, integration patterns, metadata, security, and AI enablement; define reusable standards and reference architectures. Partner with client leadership to define data modernization and AI transformation roadmaps, aligning business outcomes with scalable, secure, and cost-effective architectures. Lead solution design and technical governance across data engineering, integration, cloud, DevOps, and AI workloads—ensuring architectural integrity from discovery through production. Drive GenAI adoption, collaborating with ZS innovation teams to deploy use cases such as RAG-based assistants, data discovery copilots, automation agents, and synthetic data solutions, with strong human-in-the-loop and governance controls. Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders—supporting opportunity shaping, solution proposals, and articulation of ZS’s differentiated data & AI vision. Build and mentor high-performing teams across global delivery hubs; strengthen engineering practices, documentation standards, and knowledge assets through CoE-style leadership. What you’ll bring : Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or Engineering. 10–14 years in technology consulting or delivery with a strong focus on one or more industries: Travel, Hospitality, Retail, Financial Services, QSR, or Agri‑Tech. Understanding of core commercial/operational systems in chosen sectors (e.g., PMS, CRS, POS, FMS, CRM, loyalty systems in hospitality/retail). Strong hands‑on understanding of cloud‑native architectures, microservices, data engineering, and integration frameworks . Demonstrated experience leading multi‑disciplinary global teams through architecture design, delivery governance, and client relationship management . Hands-on experience with enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, and familiarity with methodologies like C4, UML, and RUP 4+1 is preferred. Proven ability to bridge business and technology—from defining business drivers and KPIs to mapping enabling platforms and execution plans. Experience working with US or global enterprise clients; familiarity with large transformation or modernization programs preferred. Exposure to AI/ML or GenAI‑enabled automation use cases is an advantage. Excellent communication, presentation, and client engagement skills—comfortable at both strategic and technical levels. Prior experience in a professional services/consulting environment preferred. Finance Associate - Client Accounting (Sales Operations) We seek a financial professional for a Finance Associate - Client Accounting role in our Pune, India office. As an Associate in Sales Operations / Order Management, within Client Accounting, you will support the contract-to-project setup process for professional services engagements helping ensure signed client documents (e.g., MSA/SOW/PO) are translated into accurate SAP customer project/WBS and billing setup so delivery teams can execute and Finance can invoice and apply revenue policies. Your work is execution-focused and completed within defined SOPs, templates, and checklists, with routine review by senior team members and clear escalation paths for exceptions. SAP services project setup support (functional end-user scope) You will support foundational setup activities that enable billing, using guided processes rather than configuration work. Support creation/maintenance of billing items for customer projects, in collaboration or overlap with billing team (including selecting contract type such as Fixed Price or Time & Expenses; assigning work packages; entering amounts/caps; maintaining billing due dates/billing plan items; and capturing customer references such as PO) Cross-functional coordination (primarily internal-facing) Coordinate with Sales, Delivery/Project teams, and finance to collect missing inputs, clarify basic items (e.g., dates, PO references, billing schedule), and keep the setup moving through the standard workflow. Provide routine status updates and document actions/decisions taken, maintaining an audit-ready trail of changes and approvals as required by the workflow. Documentation hygiene and operational reporting support Maintain organized records and trackers (e.g., contract intake status, setup progress, exception logs) to support day-to-day visibility and handoffs. Support basic operational reporting aligned to the process (e.g., volumes processed, cycle time, rework themes) as defined by the team’s governance model. Contract elements you will typically review and validate within Associate scope of experience & expertise You will focus on operationally actionable contract elements that drive project setup and billing structure—not legal interpretation. Common validation checklist items include: Scope/deliverables and timelines: ensuring deliverables, milestones, and timelines are stated clearly enough to align to project structure and billing phases. Payment structure and triggers: confirming whether billing is milestone-based, periodic, or time & expenses—and ensuring the setup can reflect those triggers. Basic contract data required for setup: parties/contact information, effective/expiration dates, and required customer references (e.g., PO) for linkage to sales/billing documents. Billing plan and method alignment: verifying that the invoice method and revenue method classification selected/entered aligns to the contracted payment structure (and escalating mismatches). Revenue recognition awareness (coordination-only; no accounting ownership) You are expected to have awareness of ASC 606/IFRS 15 concepts and recognize when contract terms may impact Finance’s revenue decisions; however, you do not determine accounting treatment, standalone selling price allocation, or final revenue recognition conclusions. Practical awareness expected: Familiarity with the five-step model structure (identify contract; identify performance obligations; determine transaction price; allocate price; recognize revenue) at a high level, so you can spot terms that could affect setup and downstream treatment. Accuracy and attention to detail: when translating contract terms into SAP billing/project setup fields. Process discipline: ability to follow SOPs, maintain documentation, and preserve required audit trails. Clear written communication: for internal coordination and structured escalation. Comfort working with global stakeholders: through defined handoffs, including support for contracts across regions via documented workflows. Effective oral and written communication skills that enable strong relationship-building and stakeholder management. Strong attention to detail. Motivated and proactive. Professional objectivity and judgment to know when to challenge activities. Ability to multi-task in a fast paced, rapidly-changing environment. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS. As a Senior UX/UI Designer at ZS Associates, you will help lead the design of AI-powered digital products, predictive analytics interfaces, and enterprise-scale healthcare solutions. You’ll guide experience strategy, translate research insights into scalable design patterns, and collaborate closely with UX designers, researchers, and developers to bring intuitive, high-quality interfaces to life across web and mobile platforms. Your work will include creating wireframes, high-fidelity mock-ups, interactive prototypes, and polished design assets, as well as contributing to design systems that ensure consistency across products. You will also leverage GenAI design tools to accelerate key workflows from research synthesis to ideation and prototyping—while conducting UI audits to enhance usability, accessibility, and visual coherence. The ideal candidate combines strong visual design skills with a deep understanding of usability principles, accessibility best practices, and modern design heuristics. Familiarity with GenAI design accelerators and the ability to communicate design rationale clearly will be essential as you help shape conversations with clients and internal teams. Apply structured problem-solving and systems thinking to break down ambiguous problem spaces. Ability to map complex business rules, multi-role workflows, and process dependencies into intuitive user journeys. What you’ll do : UX/UI Design: Strong visual design skills with the ability to create modern, intuitive interfaces for complex web and mobile applications. Experience producing wireframes, mockups, prototypes, style guides, icons, and other core UI assets. Ability to collaborate with UX leads, developers, and cross-functional teams throughout the user-centered design process. Understanding of usability, accessibility, design heuristics, and platform-specific technical limitations. Proficiency with design and prototyping tools (Figma, Axure, HTML prototypes, etc.). Ability to design AI-driven workflows, predictive dashboards, conversational UI, and GenAI-enabled experiences. Skill in translating business and analytics requirements into scalable interaction patterns and high-fidelity designs. Familiarity with using generative AI tools to accelerate research synthesis, ideation, and design variations. Experience contributing to or evolving design systems, including components for AI-powered products. Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate with clients and guide junior designers. Ability to support or conduct UX research and synthesize insights into actionable design direction. Experience facilitating workshops, design reviews, and design sprints for concept validation. Strong experience designing multi-level analytics dashboards. Ability to translate analytical metrics into clear, intuitive, decision-support UI components. What you’ll bring: Qualifications ZS welcomes candidates who hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a visual design field, including graphic design, interaction design, illustration, or a comparable design discipline. We are looking for individuals with 5–7 years of experience in UX/UI Design, with a strong focus on designing and delivering complex, high-volume, high-profile business or enterprise applications such as portals, business applications, mobile apps, interactive dashboards, data visualizations, and information-rich systems. Candidates should have experience designing analytics-driven and AI-enabled workflows, including conversational interfaces, recommendation systems, decision-support tools, and agentic task flows. Proficiency with GenAI design tools, the ability to structure ambiguous problem spaces, and the capability to develop scalable interaction patterns are highly valued. Strong communication skills, client collaboration experience, and the ability to explain and defend design decisions are essential. The role requires strong teamwork and leadership capabilities. Experience mentoring junior designers, contributing to design systems, and applying core consulting skills such as managing tasks, synthesizing feedback, and articulating design choices is important. Familiarity with regulated industries such as healthcare or pharma is a plus. Your skills will help us deliver UX design services to clients, stakeholders, and internal teams as you participate in a user-centered, collaborative design process. How you’ll grow: Ability to proactively identify and address issues independently, and display ownership of and responsibility for work. A functional understanding of enterprise software is preferred, as well as being adept at collaborating with other members of the UX team and technical teams to reach feasible design solutions for portals, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems, content management systems, collaboration technologies, and Business Intelligence (BI) systems. Previous experience working in pharmaceutical industry and knowledge of healthcare is a plus UXUI Experience: A strong portfolio featuring design work for enterprise, that showcases visual design for mobile or desktop applications, infographics, iconography, logos or other design work, and how it leads to positive business outcomes. Strong hands-on experience with modern design tools such as Figma, Figma Make, AI-powered design tools, and the Adobe Creative Suite (especially Adobe Illustrator). Demonstrated ability to translate a client’s brand into modern-looking user interfaces and other digital multimedia, following visual design best practices for mobile and desktop applications. Demonstrated ability to create and follow a style guide or other visual design documentation and leverage it to execute mock-ups for clients and stakeholders. Proficiency designing for GenAI and AI-powered experiences , including chat UX, agentic task flows, AI copilots, explainable AI (XAI) elements, recommendation UX, and multi-step AI-driven workflows. Ability to structure AI-assisted decision journeys with rationales, confidence indicators, next actions, and safety boundaries. Experience collaborating with and/or supporting user experience research and/or design teams is a plus. An understanding of modern BI tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) and low code applications (e.g. Power Apps, SFDC), as well as UI Frameworks is highly desirable. Experience working with cross-functional teams, including UX, business (e.g. Marketing, Sales), product management and/or technology/IT/engineering) is a plus. Client Management and Communication: Strong oral and written communication skills, especially the ability to clearly articulate and document design decisions with stakeholders and development teams and keep UX and Project Team leads up to date. Excellent collaboration skills and the ability to contribute to design discussions that help to obtain consensus and move projects forward. Ability to participate in a team environment where individuals can communicate and contribute freely. Listens carefully to client and team requests, asks questions that help to drive discussions forward. Ability to communicate complex information in a meaningful way that is easy to understand. Candidates should have the ability to travel to client locations (25%) to work with teams and provide in-person expertise. Candidates must possess permanent work authorization for their intended country of employment. An on-line application, including a cover letter expressing interest and a portfolio is required to be considered. Hybrid working model: ZS is committed to a Flexible and Connected way of working. ZSers are onsite at clients or ZS offices three days a week. Combined flexibility to work remotely two days a week is also available. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.
